title: A room for light
description: Ultramarine shutters lift in sequence to reveal two architectural studies.
useCase: Introduce a selected architectural project, an art direction study or a visual case study with a brief material reveal.
reducedMotion: The study and caption change immediately. Keyboard activation skips the shutter sequence.
limitations: The seven-panel reveal is decorative and does not hide interactive controls. Replace both original SVG illustrations with equally sized artwork when adapting.
look: Isometric building illustration in stone, grey and cobalt above a cream caption bar with blue sans type, monospace labels and a square blue button.
motion: Clicking the arrow instantly covers the art with seven ultramarine panels that lift upward in a 45 ms stagger, 820 ms each with a strong ease-out, revealing the next study.
adapt: The reveal is the `sf-shutters-open` keyframe (820 ms) on the `sf-shutters-blinds` panels, staggered by inline `animationDelay` (index × 45 ms) and replayed by remounting on `scene.sequence`. Replace `Architecture` and the captions; keep the `event.detail` check that skips it for keyboard.
